_about: UGRC-specific palette tokens that have no equivalent in Protomaps' namedFlavor('dark') -
hillshade grades, road-class grays, rail/trail/transit, park/water/boundary variants, and
the extra label tier. These are layered on top of the tokens fetched live from Protomaps
at build time (see src/ugrc_styles/palette.py) to form the final palette.
'shield_text' is new: the color for highway-shield route numbers once the shield icon
itself has been shadowed (see src/ugrc_styles/sprites.py) - needs to read clearly against
the shield's now-shadowed fill, so it sits lighter than the regular road-label grays.
Discipline: nothing here may duplicate an actual Protomaps flavor value - if a token's
color legitimately comes from Protomaps (matches namedFlavor('dark') either by value or by
clear intent, e.g. hillshade's base tone = the land fill), it belongs in palette.py's
PROTOMAPS_KEY_MAP instead, so a copy of this repo pointed at a different flavor (e.g. light)
picks it up automatically. Only genuinely UGRC-original tokens with no Protomaps equivalent
